name: com.halffee/coinrebate
title: CoinRebate
description: Compliance-filtered crypto exchange fee comparison and rebate-link routing for AI agents.

tools.name: get_exchange_fees
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Get the benchmark trading fees from CoinRebate's published fee table for every covered exchange: spot and futures maker/taker fees (VIP 0 base tier) and the same fees after the CoinRebate referral discount. These are published rates, not live order-book data: fees.fee_table_updated is the date an exchange's entry in the table was last updated, while data_source and fetched_at only describe CoinRebate's automated refresh check. Use it only for questions about exchange trading fees and fee discounts.

tools.name: compare_fees
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Compare the benchmark trading fees from CoinRebate's published fee table across the covered exchanges for one purpose (spot or futures). Returns the exchanges ranked by lowest taker fee after the CoinRebate referral discount. Pass a country code for compliance-filtered results. Use it only for questions about exchange trading fees and fee discounts.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, CN, VN) for compliance filtering

current_exchange.description: Exchange the user already trades on, if any. Binance (any spelling) lists Binance alone at its standard fee, with no link and no other exchange

query.description: The user's own words, if available; a mention of Binance is treated like current_exchange=binance

tools.name: get_exchange_referral
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Look up the referral code, fee discount and signup link that CoinRebate lists for one exchange, together with the published maker and taker fees of that exchange before and after the discount. Pass a country to apply the availability records CoinRebate keeps for that country. Use it only for questions about an exchange referral code, signup link or fee discount.

exchange.description: Exchange name (binance, okx, bybit, bitget, gate, hyperliquid)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for compliance check

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Get CoinRebate's most recently published English-language articles (market analysis, guides and news), newest first: up to five by default, at most 20. Returns each article's title, publication date and link, and says so when the newest English-language article is more than three days old. The newest article can be weeks old; latest_date and latest_age_days say how old. Use it only when the user asks what CoinRebate has published.

limit.description: Maximum number of English-language articles to return (1-20; up to 5 by default)

tools.name: calculate_trading_cost
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Estimate the taker-fee cost of a trading volume on one exchange, with and without the CoinRebate referral discount, using the benchmark taker fee from CoinRebate's published fee table. Returns the fee on that volume, the difference, a yearly figure that assumes the volume is monthly, and the date of the fee-table entry used. Use it only for questions about exchange trading fees and fee discounts.

exchange.description: Exchange name (binance, okx, bybit, bitget, gate, hyperliquid)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for compliance filtering

tools.name: get_compliant_exchanges
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Get exchanges available in a specific country, filtered by the per-exchange availability records CoinRebate keeps (the restricted-country list of each exchange, the same records its own referral links use). It does not confirm that a resident can open an account or a given product; the terms and checks of each exchange decide. Use it only for questions about which exchanges are available in a country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, CN, BR, VN, PH, IN)

purpose.description: Trading purpose filter: spot or futures

tools.name: recommend_fee_option
tools.description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Decide which covered exchange has the lowest effective trading fee for a specific user, instead of returning a table. Pass the user's country when it is known: without it the answer still names the cheapest covered venue, but gives no referral code or link and does not check availability where the user lives. Without monthly_volume_usd it assumes $10,000 a month (a typical retail trader at VIP 0) and says so. If the user already trades on Binance, the answer stays on Binance (how to pay less on that account) and names no other exchange. Returns one verdict plus its net fee, the quantified annual cost, the assumptions and what is NOT modelled, and a commercial disclosure. Abstains (neutral fee table only) when the country code is not a valid one, the upstream data is unreliable, or the top venues are exactly tied with no fee-benefit difference; says so plainly when no covered venue is available in the country. In high-regulation jurisdictions it returns an objective fee table with no signup link. Use it only for questions about exchange trading fees and fee discounts.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the END USER (recommended: the ranking is compliance-filtered by it, and a referral code or link is given only when it is known)

monthly_volume_usd.description: Monthly trading volume in USD; omitted means an assumed $10,000 a month, stated in the answer

current_exchange.description: Exchange the user already trades on, if any. Binance (any spelling, anywhere in the text) keeps the answer on Binance; an existing account is quoted at its standard fee with no referral code or link

query.description: The user's question in their own words, if available; if it mentions Binance, the answer stays on Binance

tools.name: list_tradfi_perps
tools.description: Lists Binance USDⓈ-M perpetuals on US, HK, KR, and CN stocks plus commodities from the official exchangeInfo endpoint.

tools.name: get_perp_stats
tools.description: Gets daily, weekly, 30-day, and historical weekly-rank statistics for a Binance TradFi perpetual from official Binance klines.

symbol.description: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual symbol, for example TSLAUSDT

tools.name: check_referral_link
tools.description: Checks whether a URL carries CoinRebate's own current referral code (allowlisted exchange hosts only). This is a self-check for CoinRebate links: a link carrying someone else's code is reported as stale_code even though it may be perfectly valid. For a neutral inspection of any exchange link, use inspect_exchange_link.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches CoinRebate's published guides by keyword (any language) and returns matching articles with title, one-line description and URL. Read-only; results are informational articles, not referral links.

tools.name: inspect_exchange_link
tools.description: Inspects an exchange sign-up or referral link and reports evidence on five separate points: whether the domain is a verified official domain of a listed exchange, whether it is reachable, whose referral code it carries, how CoinRebate's records list the exchange for a given country, and what rebate (if any) is configured. Unknown items are reported as unknown. It never says a link is safe, never probes unrecognized domains, and never suggests a replacement link. Read-only.
